strengths: Strong empirical results with consistent +10.1 average improvement across four diverse personalized detection benchmarks, verified with statistical significance tests (p < 10^-17)
Comprehensive experimental methodology including oracle experiments, ablation studies, dimensionality analysis, and qualitative visualizations that effectively validate design choices
Well-designed three-stage approach combining multimodal supervision, feature translation via attention+MLP, and dual-objective loss for both local alignment and geometric regularization
Practical system requiring no teacher at inference with minimal overhead, suitable for resource-constrained deployment on mobile robotics and edge devices

Few-shot learning limited to prototypical networks only; no comparison with other FSL methods; acknowledged limitation that prototype classifier is 'inefficient at large scales' limits practical applicability; evaluation with only 1-5 support samples is artificial

Missing critical analyses: no error analysis or failure modes; no explanation of dataset-specific performance variations (why MOCHA helps more on PerSeg/POD); no quantification of inference overhead from translation module; insufficient detail on teacher feature extraction (token averaging for h_i unclear)

Reproducibility gaps: hyperparameter values (λ_dist, λ_emb) not specified; exact teacher inference procedure incompletely detailed; code availability not mentioned; some implementation details ambiguous (how frozen teacher processes boxes)

Technical justifications lacking: PCA power-law fitting appears post-hoc without principled explanation; choice of L1+L2 loss versus alternatives not justified; temperature τ selection not discussed; translation module design not compared to alternatives
Oracle experiments suggest strong initialization from AuXFT weights is crucial (+3.7 point boost), raising questions about fair comparison; unclear if all baselines use identical initialization

strengths: Comprehensive experimental evaluation across four personalized detection datasets with rigorous statistical testing (Wilcoxon signed-rank, p < 10^-17) and extensive ablations

Clear methodology, detailed pseudocode, and reproducibility details well-documented
weaknesses: Limited algorithmic novelty: primarily combines established techniques (standard knowledge distillation, transformer encoder translation module, metric learning-style relational losses) without substantial innovation. Insufficient theoretical insight into why multimodal supervision helps region-level alignment; claims about 'relational consistency' and neural collapse mitigation lack rigorous support; toy example in Fig. 3 is illustrative but trivial

Incomplete hyperparameter analysis: λ_dist, λ_emb, τ values not provided; no sensitivity analysis; missing ablations on γ, τ, and translator design; feature similarity visualization (Fig. 5) difficult to interpret
Scalability limitations acknowledged in appendix: prototypical network 'inherently inefficient at large scales,' severely constraining real-world deployment with many personal object classes

No code availability mentioned; reproducibility concerns regarding hyperparameter selection and design choice justifications; results not validated on standard detection benchmarks, limiting generalization claims
